newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Profit warning knocks Afcol to year low.
newsitem.headline: Profit warning knocks Afcol to year low.

text.p: A profit warning earlier on Monday sent South Africa's Associated Furniture Companies Ltd (Afcol) shares to a year low of 13.00 rand.
"Definitely on the warning," one dealer said when asked what had knocked the share.
The share lost 100 cents from its previous close of 14 rand. Volumes, however, were fairly thin in line with the overall market. By 1000 GMT 6,000 shares had changed hands.
The company said that earnings in the year to March 31, 1997, would be well below expectations due to a sharp deterioration in demand for furniture in the fourth quarter.

It said in a statement that attributable earnings for the full year would be well below the level indicated at the time interim results were announced in November, although earnings would be above the 25.7 million rand recorded at the half year.
The company will publish year results on May 8.
Afcol's previous year low was 13.60 rand.
